    Background (pseudo-absence) subsampling for presence-background data

    Source: R/recipes-steps.R
    step_inv_background.Rd

    step_inv_background() creates a specification of a recipe step that subsamples the background (or absence) rows of a presence-background data set so that there are ratio background rows for every presence. With method = "stratified" the background is first clustered by k-means on the numeric predictors and sampled evenly across clusters, which spreads the background across environmental space. Because it changes the number of rows, the step is skipped when baking new data by default.

    Usage

    step_inv_background(
  recipe,
  ...,
  role = NA,
  trained = FALSE,
  ratio = 10,
  event = NULL,
  method = c("random", "stratified"),
  n_strata = 10,
  column = NULL,
  predictors = NULL,
  seed = sample.int(10^5, 1),
  skip = TRUE,
  id = recipes::rand_id("inv_background")
)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_background'
prep(x, training, info = NULL, ...)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_background'
bake(object, new_data, ...)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_background'
print(x, width = max(20, options()$width - 30), ...)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_background'
tidy(x, ...)

# S3 method for class 'step_inv_background'
required_pkgs(x, ...)

    Arguments

    recipe

    A recipe object.

    ...

    One or more selector functions choosing the presence column: logical, 0/1 or a two-level factor.

    role

    Not used by this step since no new variables are created.

    trained

    A logical to indicate if the step has been trained.

    ratio

    Number of background rows to keep per presence.

    event

    Value of the presence column that marks presences. Defaults to TRUE, 1 or the first factor level.

    method

    "random" or "stratified" (k-means on numeric predictors).

    n_strata

    Number of k-means clusters for method = "stratified".

    column, predictors

    Set by prep(): the presence column and the numeric predictors used for stratification.

    seed

    Integer seed for reproducible subsampling.

    skip

    A logical. Should the step be skipped when the recipe is baked by bake()? Defaults to TRUE because the step removes rows.

    id

    A character string that is unique to this step.

    x

    A step_inv_background object.

    training

    A data frame used to train the step.

    info

    Variable information from the recipe.

    object

    A trained step.

    new_data

    A data frame to process.

    width

    Print width.

    Value

    An updated recipe with the new step added. tidy() returns a tibble with columns terms, ratio, method and id.

    References

    Barbet-Massin, M., Jiguet, F., Albert, C. H. and Thuiller, W. (2012). Selecting pseudo-absences for species distribution models: how, where and how many? Methods in Ecology and Evolution, 3, 327-338. doi:10.1111/j.2041-210X.2011.00172.x

    Examples

    library(recipes)
#> Loading required package: dplyr
#> 
#> Attaching package: ‘dplyr’
#> The following objects are masked from ‘package:stats’:
#> 
#>     filter, lag
#> The following objects are masked from ‘package:base’:
#> 
#>     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
#> 
#> Attaching package: ‘recipes’
#> The following object is masked from ‘package:stats’:
#> 
#>     step
rec <- recipe(presence ~ temp + rain + forest, data = inv_sdm_data) |>
  step_inv_background(presence, ratio = 2, seed = 1)
prepped <- prep(rec)
table(bake(prepped, new_data = NULL)$presence)
#> 
#>   presence background 
#>        271        542 
tidy(prepped, number = 1)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 4
#>   terms    ratio method id                  
#>   <chr>    <dbl> <chr>  <chr>               
#> 1 presence     2 random inv_background_Y0psJ
